title: HtmlTemplate
responsibility: Renders the native template element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTemplate.attributes
inputs.description: Native template attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTemplate.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native template element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTemplate
outputs.description: The actual native template element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
